data_point: Shopify or similar storefront that does not hold inventory
run_when: Code found a store platform but no proof of physical stock.

prompt.task: Decide whether the company runs a Shopify-type storefront that does NOT hold inventory: digital goods, print-on-demand or dropshipping.
prompt.definition: This lowers the score but never disqualifies. Not excluded, but the storefront integration is a known gap.
yes_when: Store sells digital goods, print-on-demand or dropshipped items
no_when: No storefront, or it holds its own stock (that's the exclusion)
unknown_when: Can't tell how products are fulfilled

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.

queries: "{company}" "print on demand" OR dropshipping OR "digital products"
